raw_segments.text: In Parthia did I take thee prisoner, and then I swore thee, saving of thy life, that whatsoever
I did bid thee do, thou shouldst attempt it.
Now be a freeman, and with this good sword that ran through Caesar's bowels, search
Here, take thou the hilts, and when my face is covered, as teas now guide thou the sword.
Caesar, thou art revenged, even with the sword that killed thee."
